title: CRWV Stock Gains Premarket Amid Market Rebound: Neocloud Operator Announces $3.5B Debt Raise
source_used: Stocktwits; text from WORKDIR/fulltext/C09-12.txt; dates checked on Google News
key_facts: CoreWeave announced plans to issue $3.5 billion of senior notes due 2032, in US dollars and euros.
Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including repaying debt and covering fees.
CoreWeave has raised over $20 billion in notes due 2030 to 2032 since its March 2025 IPO.
Last quarter revenue rose 111% to $2.08 billion; the net loss was a record $1.48 billion.
Shares are down over 20% from a 1 June peak and up 33% for the year (as of the article).
Bloomberg reported that its three top executives have sold $2.3 billion of stock since the IPO.
quote_evidence: The neocloud operator announced early in the day plans to issue $3.5 billion in senior notes due in 2032, comprising both U.S. dollar- and euro-denominated debt.
The company intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including repayment of outstanding indebtedness, and to pay fees, costs and expenses in connection with the offering.
CoreWeave’s revenue increased 111% year over year to $2.08 billion in the last quarter.
why_it_matters_hint: An AI cloud company keeps borrowing heavily to expand, with record losses.
event_date: 11 Jun 2026 (Google News shows a Business Wire notice dated 10 Jun 2026 and TradingView 11 Jun 2026)
notes: OLDER NEWS RE-DATED: the article calls the day Thursday, mentions Oracle results and a 1 June peak, and Google News shows the same $3.5 billion senior-notes offer announced on 10 to 11 Jun 2026. The pool's 7 Oct stamp is wrong. CoreWeave's later September 2026 convertible-notes offerings are separate.
